description: This Java source file defines the class FinAccountPaymentServices, which provides services related to financial account payment operations such as pre-authorization, capture, refund, withdrawal, deposit, and auto-replenishment within the OFBiz framework. It handles interactions with financial accounts, including validation, authorization, and transaction creation, and references multiple external services and entities.

classes.name: FinAccountPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides services for managing financial account payments, including authorization, capture, refund, withdrawal, deposit, and auto-replenishment within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: finAccountPreAuth
methods.description: Performs pre-authorization of a financial account, validating account status, PIN, expiration, and available balance, and creating an authorization transaction if conditions are met.

methods.name: finAccountReleaseAuth
methods.description: Releases (expires) a financial account authorization transaction.

methods.name: finAccountCapture
methods.description: Captures funds against a previously authorized financial account transaction, ensuring authorization and account validity.

methods.name: finAccountRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund by depositing funds into a financial account.

methods.name: finAccountWithdraw
methods.description: Withdraws funds from a financial account, verifying sufficient balance and account validity.

methods.name: finAccountDeposit
methods.description: Deposits funds into a financial account, updating balances and handling negative balances with potential status updates.

methods.name: finAccountReplenish
methods.description: Automatically replenishes a financial account when balance falls below a threshold, creating orders and deposits to restore funds.

methods.name: getLastProductStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves the last used product store ID for a given financial account based on recent deposit transactions or defaults.

methods.name: createFinAcctPaymentTransaction
methods.description: Creates a financial account payment transaction, including payment creation, transaction record, and linking to the account.
